scope: Hodram's first sailing and sail-trim tutorial (SC1 block 127)

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.context: Hodram orders the fleet to depart.
records.source_meaning: Raise anchor and set the sails.

records.speaker: Manuel
records.context: Manuel asks Hodram to choose a course.
records.source_meaning: Manuel asks the admiral for the sailing direction.

records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.source_meaning: The sailing direction is chosen with the D-pad or touch screen.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Press toward your heading, or tap the screen.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.source_meaning: Press the D-pad toward the desired heading or tap that direction on screen.
records.localization_note: Compact instruction for the fixed allocation.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adelknauts
records.context: Gerhard reminds Hodram to trim the sails.
records.source_meaning: Do not forget to command the sails.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Use L and R to turn the sails. Proper trim increases speed.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.source_meaning: Turn the sails with L and R; proper adjustment increases ship speed.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Use L for left; use R for right.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.source_meaning: L rotates the sails left and R rotates them right.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Stylus steering trims sails. Tap flagship to stop.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.source_meaning: Stylus steering automatically adjusts the sails; touching the flagship stops it.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Watch the speed meter above. Trim the sails until its bar is longest.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.source_meaning: The upper-screen speed meter shows speed; adjust sails until the bar becomes longest.

records.english: {SPEAKER:10}Now we'll crush the Hanseatic ships and show Martin Speyer he underestimated us!{PAD}
records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.context: Hodram states his objective after learning the sailing controls.
records.source_meaning: Hodram vows to defeat the Hanseatic ships and prove Martin Speyer wrong for mocking him.
records.localization_note: Retains the named rival and Hodram's boastful tone.
